item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00105","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C06","C22","C18"],"selected_candidate_label":"C06","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C06 is a direct drafting template for the child letters. The child preserves C06's distinctive sequence and nearly verbatim language: reliance on reports from the Office of Defense Mobilization and Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service; the presidential finding that the dispute substantially threatens national defense; referral under E.O. 10233; instructions that the Board investigate and recommend fair and equitable settlement terms; discussion of the strike's effect on critical defense production and exhausted mediation; transfer of the dispute record; and the closing appeal for a return to work while Board machinery operates. C22 is another close use of the same form, while C18 supplies the underlying legal machinery and some operative wording but is less directly the letter template.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"On the basis of the information and advice submitted to me by the Office of Defense Mobilization and the Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service, I am of the opinion that the dispute ... is of a character which substantially threatens the progress of national defense.","parent_excerpt":"On the basis of the information and advice submitted to me by the Office of Defense Mobilization and the Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service, I am of the opinion that the dispute ... is of a character which substantially threatens the progress of national defense.","explanation":"Distinctive introductory finding is reproduced almost verbatim, with only the parties and location changed."},{"child_excerpt":"Thus, in accordance with the terms of E.O. 10233, I am referring the dispute to the Wage Stabilization Board and asking that the Board investigate and inquire into the issues in dispute and promptly report to me with its recommendations to the parties as to fair and equitable terms of settlement.","parent_excerpt":"Thus, in accordance with the terms of E.O. 10233, I am referring the dispute to the Wage Stabilization Board and asking that the Board investigate and inquire into the issues in dispute and promptly report to me with its recommendations to the parties as to fair and equitable terms of settlement.","explanation":"The central operative referral and requested Board action are identical."},{"child_excerpt":"The report of the Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service indicates that negotiations to date have been unsuccessful and that, although full use has been made of mediation and conciliation facilities, the strike persists and is likely to persist. I am asking the Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service to provide the Board with a record of the issues in dispute.","parent_excerpt":"It is clear from the report of the Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service that negotiations to date have been fruitless and that, although full use has been made of mediation and conciliation facilities, the strike persists and is likely to persist. I am asking the Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service to provide the Board with a record of the issues in dispute.","explanation":"The child closely tracks both the exhausted-mediation finding and the administrative direction to provide the Board's record."},{"child_excerpt":"It is my earnest hope that the men involved will comply with your request that they return to work while the matter is before the Board and that the utilization of the Board's machinery will thus serve its purpose of restoring to production the facilities necessary to the national defense.","parent_excerpt":"It is my earnest hope that the men involved will comply with your request that they return to work while the matter is before the Board and that the utilization of the Board's machinery will thus serve its purpose of restoring to production the facilities necessary to the national defense.","explanation":"The distinctive closing appeal and description of the Board's machinery are copied verbatim."}]}
